title: Kahneman and Tversky's 1979 prospect theory
summary: The Econometrica paper models losses as weighing more than equal gains in people's choices.
body: Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky, "Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk" (Econometrica, 1979), is the paper behind loss aversion as a modeled feature of choices under risk. The v1 article says losses feel roughly twice as bad as gains. A coefficient near 2 is associated with their fits. This card does not restate a fitted number that was not re-read from a table. The sourced claim is that the 1979 theory treats losses and gains asymmetrically.
